title: Infinite Dungeons
description: Head down a bottomless dungeon with your friends, through the Smoldering Crypt and the lava and furnaces of The Sunken Forge: smash skeletons and forge brutes, grab rarer and rarer weapons, bring down the Bone Colossus, the Ossuary Warden and The Forgemaster, then leave with your loot or go deeper. Up to 4 players on one screen, with keyboard, mouse or controllers, or solo with an AI companion. Also playable in French.
controls: Keyboard and mouse: W A S D to move (Z Q S D on AZERTY keyboards), the mouse to aim, left click to attack, right click for the power, Space to dodge, E to pick up, open or revive
Second player on the same keyboard: the arrow keys to move (aiming and attacking are automatic), Enter or Right Shift to dodge, / for the power (! on AZERTY), . to pick up (: on AZERTY)
Controller: left stick to move, right stick to aim and attack, RT for the power, LT to dodge, A to pick up, open or revive
Hero screen: C (or Y on a controller) adds an AI companion
Esc or Start: pause. M: mute. F: fullscreen, from the menus
